project_in_one_sentence.value: FIELDWISE will use heterogeneous 2022-2026 MATE physiological, soil, meteorological and proximal spectral observations to build and validate the first processing-tomato module of a physiologically grounded, crop-configurable irrigation decision-support framework for irrigated high-value horticulture; develop an interpretable HUN-REN-led predictive workflow; bridge sensing scales with ELTE hyperspectral/UAV/EO expertise; test transfer prospectively in a newly instrumented commercial farmer field; and translate the validated architecture into a DrR web MVP designed for later crop-specific extension and evaluated by AgroVIR.

core_message.value: FIELDWISE moves crop-stress modelling beyond retrospective accuracy by asking whether a physiologically meaningful water-stress signal survives unseen years, a new real production environment and a change of sensing scale — and whether the validated workflow can be separated into a reusable decision-support core and crop-specific biological/calibration components. Processing tomato is the evidence-rich starting crop; the ambition is a scientifically controlled pathway toward additional irrigated high-value horticultural crops, not a universal tomato model imposed on all crops.
